visual_summary: A double-page space battle spread. At top left, a large sleek white vessel is identified as a neutral diplomatic ship. At top right, armored and ceremonial-looking figures observe a tactical display from an interior command space while narration says the match is being signaled to begin. Below, fleets and weapons fire fill space: small craft move near a bright planetary or stellar edge, a huge white explosion blossoms, and a massive gun battery dominates the right page. At the bottom, two fast-moving luminous forms streak together into a dark circular void, visually representing a black hole that swallows them.
